# Native PropAMM evidence

- `accounts.json`: generated by the router's `tests/fixtures/prop_amm/generate.rs`
  from PropAMM `6c3574c23a2c4ec31fe81e86b84cbfa6f6cdd105`, using native config
  serialization and PDA helpers. Includes the v2 discriminator, immutable
  config identity, config-owned vault derivations, and both network program IDs.
- `trades.json`: the testnet cases from the same generator, omitting the standalone
  account list. The 50-byte native CPI retains original compact terms, measured
  input and minimum. The router encodes only the terms.
- `router-transactions.json`: exported by the updated router's
  `tests/runtime/src/lib.rs::tests::export_router_transactions` after executing
  each transaction against the real v2 PropAMM and router SBF programs. Eight
  signed transactions cover Buy/Sell × swap, redeem/swap, swap/mint and
  redeem/swap/mint, using input ATA + router instructions and config-owned vaults.
  See the router's `tests/runtime/README.md` for the export command. All keys,
  account states and time are synthetic.

SDK tests reconstruct instructions and compare the entire compiled message and
serialized transaction to these Rust bytes. They include both signatures in size
measurement; the three-hop cases are 1,225 bytes with shared fee destinations.
Tests do not read sibling checkouts or establish live deployment compatibility.
